designNotes.source: Original greybox inspired by the published factory / junkyard / lower-area combat roles; no copied imagery, geometry or IP assets.
designNotes.north: Dense open-door workshops with roofs, narrow alleys and a raised gantry for close combat and infiltration.
designNotes.center: Staggered climbable scrap stacks, overhead walkway and wider sight gaps; relay 1 and the nearer B/Y core approaches hold the main line.
designNotes.south: Open-air lower service basin at Y0, 18m below the yard. Central ledges are one-way drops. Two outer 120m stepped ramps provide longer returns; directed public nav models the drops.
designNotes.objectives: Three finite cores per team ABC/XYZ, six neutral relays. All routes use shared movement, fuel, ammunition and perception rules.
